referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes a power distribution unit used in the power electronics of the drivetrain for an electric passenger car. It is based on direct informatino frmo the Swiss manufacturer Brusa. The entries are given as a function of kg device. The specific power distribution unit which was used for this dataset weights 3.9 kg and is suitable for a 100kW electric drivetrain.; UUID: d55703ae-bc31-3185-83c3-d12360cdc5d7
